docs.text: I crashed my drone into my fence after I took this one. First crash since I put my last drone into Lake Michigan, and I only broke one leg off it so I think I'm getting better at this. #sunset #puremichigan #photography

Went to a drone show over Lake Michigan tonight and I have suggestions: 1) Add fireworks.
2) Use fireworks to shoot down drones.
3) Continue Space Invaders style until all drones are destroyed.
4) 'Murica.

I can't remember if I posted this, but this is a drone shot flown out over Lake Superior, about 1/4 mile, between storms. If you saw this with your own eyes, not in a boat... You'd never come back. #puremichigan #drone #photography

Took the drone out to capture the water break and lighthouse. Very chilly, Lake Michigan is trying to build ice in these frigid temps. Warm colors from the sunset. DJI 3 Mini
1/25 at f / 1.7, ISO 100
6.72mm #dronephotography #photography #lighthouse #naturephotography #winter

After I took this photo, I noticed the sand colored area on the left is made of thousands of icy orbs. The waves on lake Michigan break up the ice and over time, tumble it into spheres. Winter can be so beautiful. ❄️ #drones #photography #aerials

Flying my drone along the ice shelves of Lake Michigan this weekend. It has been fascinating to see them change over the last month! Winter at the Lake might be my favorite time. 📷: .bsky.social Mini 3 Pro #photography #dronephotography #lakemichigan #muskegon
Drone shot of Lake Michigan lighthouse at Holland MI, if I remember correctly. #puremichigan #photography
It is going to be 93 degrees today and it is already 89, so here is a drone shot of a frozen Lake Superior that we can fantasize about. #drone #puremichigan #photography

I looked at the specs on a higher end but affordable DJI drone and I know field scientists who would have gladly sacrificed a helper for one years ago oh, [student assistant]? he wandered off, never came back, we searched, but you know the [glacier/Amazon/Lake Superior] never gives up its dead 😶
